Material Assignment IFC CSV Schedule

This task starts from scratch. No local reference images are provided. Create a one-storey apartment model with assigned materials, save the model as result.ifc, and use Bonsai/IfcCSV-style IFC data export to save the material assignment schedule as result.csv.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains these files with exact relative paths: result.ifc, result.csv.
2. result.ifc is an IFC4 model with exactly one IfcProject and exactly one IfcBuildingStorey named Level 00.
3. The model contains exactly four IfcSpace elements named Living, Kitchen, Bedroom, and Bath after case, hyphen, and underscore normalization.
4. The model contains exactly these building element counts: IfcWall: 7, IfcDoor: 3, IfcWindow: 4, IfcSlab: 1, IfcBuildingElementProxy: 0.
5. Every IfcWall has a material layer set whose ordered material names are Brick, Insulation, and Gypsum; every IfcDoor has material Timber; every IfcWindow has material Aluminium.
6. result.csv has this exact header order after trimming whitespace: GlobalId, Class, TypeName, MaterialSummary, Storey.
7. result.csv has exactly 14 non-empty data rows, one for every IfcWall, IfcDoor, and IfcWindow in result.ifc, matched by GlobalId with no missing or extra GlobalIds.
8. The CSV rows contain exactly these Class counts: IfcWall: 7, IfcDoor: 3, IfcWindow: 4.
9. The CSV rows contain exactly these MaterialSummary counts: Brick | Insulation | Gypsum: 7, Timber: 3, Aluminium: 4.
10. Every CSV row has Storey equal to Level 00.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
